description.en: LZ-60 prints one output, 50 m³/h, and a height of 300 m. LZ-80 prints two output ceilings and tells you to consult the factory for height.
description.zh: LZ-60 只印一个产量 50 m³/h，高度 300 m。LZ-80 印两个产量上限，高度要咨询工厂。

directAnswer.en: LZ-60 and LZ-80 are diesel concrete pumps from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai. LZ-60 prints 6105 / 145 kW, 50 m³/h, pumping pressure 35 MPa, conveying distance 100 m and delivery height 300 m. LZ-80 prints 256 kW (Yuchai), high-pressure output ≤ 65 m³/h and low-pressure output ≤ 95 m³/h. Its delivery height cell reads consult factory standard, which is not a metre value.
directAnswer.zh: LZ-60 和 LZ-80 是河北品锦机械在邢台的柴油混凝土泵。LZ-60 印 6105 / 145 kW、50 m³/h、泵送压力 35 MPa、输送距离 100 m、输送高度 300 m。LZ-80 印 256 kW（玉柴），高压产量 ≤ 65 m³/h，低压产量 ≤ 95 m³/h。它的输送高度写着咨询工厂标准，这不是一个米数。

heading.en: Where LZ-60 and LZ-80 print different values

body.en: Theoretical output: LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h; LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Pumping pressure: LZ-60 prints 35 MPa; LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa. Conveying distance: LZ-60 prints 100 m; LZ-80 prints 120 m. Delivery height: LZ-60 prints 300 m; LZ-80 prints Consult factory standard. Max. aggregate size: LZ-60 prints 4 cm and below; LZ-80 prints 6 cm and below. Total weight: LZ-60 prints 5500 kg; LZ-80 prints 6800 kg. The same printed value on a shared label: Dimensions is 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m on both pages. These are printed cells on the Hebei Pinjin Machinery pages for concrete pumps made in Xingtai. They are not a calculated conversion from one model to the other.
body.zh: 理论输送量：LZ-60印 50 m³/h；LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。泵送压力：LZ-60印 35 MPa；LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa。输送距离：LZ-60印 100 m；LZ-80印 120 m。输送高度：LZ-60印 300 m；LZ-80印 Consult factory standard。最大骨料粒径：LZ-60印 4 cm and below；LZ-80印 6 cm and below。整机重量：LZ-60印 5500 kg；LZ-80印 6800 kg。同一标题下数值相同的有：外形尺寸两边都是 6.6 × 1.8 × 1.9 m。以上是河北品锦机械在邢台混凝土泵页面上印出的格子，不是把一台机器换算成另一台。

heading.en: Cells that exist on only one of these pumps
heading.zh: 只在其中一台泵上出现的格子

body.en: LZ-60 prints cells that LZ-80 does not: Model line LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132; Engine power 6105 / 145 kW; Delivery pipe diameter 100 / 125 mm. LZ-80 prints cells that LZ-60 does not: Engine (diesel) 256 kW (Yuchai); Hopper capacity 0.6 m³; Hydraulic pump Kawasaki double 140. A blank or missing label is not filled from the other concrete pump.
body.zh: LZ-60有、LZ-80没有的行：型号行 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132；发动机功率 6105 / 145 kW；输送管内径 100 / 125 mm。LZ-80有、LZ-60没有的行：柴油发动机 256 kW (Yuchai)；料斗容积 0.6 m³；液压泵 Kawasaki double 140。缺了的标题不能用另一台混凝土泵来补。

heading.en: How to read the two pages without merging them
heading.zh: 怎样分开阅读这两个页面

body.en: Do not copy LZ-60's 300 m height into the LZ-80 cell that has no metre figure. Open /en/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-60 and /en/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/ for LZ-80. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these concrete pumps in Xingtai, Hebei. The number in a commercial name is not a licence to copy output, pressure or distance. If a job needs a figure this pair does not print, use the contact page rather than inventing a bore, stroke or price.
body.zh: 不要把 LZ-60 的 300 m 高度写进 LZ-80 那个没有米数的格子。看LZ-60请打开 /zh/products/lz-60-diesel-concrete-pump/，看LZ-80请打开 /zh/products/lz-80-diesel-concrete-pump/。河北品锦机械在河北邢台制造这些混凝土泵。商品名里的数字不能用来抄产量、压力或距离。如果工况需要这对机型没有印出的数字，请走联系页，不要编造缸径、行程或价格。

question.en: Does LZ-60 print the same theoretical output as LZ-80?
question.zh: LZ-60和LZ-80的理论输送量一样吗？

answer.en: No. LZ-60 prints 50 m³/h. LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。LZ-60印 50 m³/h。LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 65 m³/h; low pressure ≤ 95 m³/h。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does LZ-60 print the same pumping pressure as LZ-80?

answer.en: No. LZ-60 prints 35 MPa. LZ-80 prints High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。LZ-60印 35 MPa。LZ-80印 High pressure ≤ 35 MPa; low pressure ≤ 22 MPa。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Does LZ-60 print the same conveying distance as LZ-80?

answer.en: No. LZ-60 prints 100 m. LZ-80 prints 120 m. Both are Hebei Pinjin Machinery catalogue cells from Xingtai, and neither cell replaces the other.
answer.zh: 不一样。LZ-60印 100 m。LZ-80印 120 m。两格都是河北品锦机械在邢台公布的目录，不能互相替代。

question.en: Why is model line missing on LZ-80?

answer.en: The LZ-80 page does not print that label. LZ-60 prints LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132. Leave the missing cell blank. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not publish a rule for copying it across concrete pumps.
answer.zh: LZ-80这一页没有印这个标题。LZ-60印的是 LZ-60 / HBT60-13.132。缺的格子保持空白。河北品锦机械没有公布把该格抄到另一台混凝土泵上的规则。
